name: IconClose
description: SEED contract for the ALTITUDE round — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Subject: altitude-web-components@1.0.2 (published npm, Lit 3, SHADOW DOM), pinned in examples/altitude/.altitude-sandbox (examples/altitude/PROVENANCE.md). EVERY enum in this library is DEFAULTLESS — the default rendering is the ABSENCE of the attribute (there is no `variant="primary"`; primary IS unset), so every axis leads with the `unset` pseudo-value. No `disabled` state plane: Altitude never reaches the `:disabled` pseudo-class from a prop on these components (al-button's isDisabled emits aria-disabled ONLY — measured identical background, cursor and opacity — and the other seven spell it as an `al-is-disabled` class, which is a prop-selected RENDERING, i.e. a variant axis, not a pseudo-class plane). al-icon-close. One of 37 SEPARATE icon ELEMENTS (there is no `al-icon name=...` router in the shipped bundle) — the glyph is an inline <svg> inside the shadow root, which is the svg-promotion path reached through the shadow reader. COMPUTED-ENRICHED (extract/computed): unlabeled styled channels minted from computed-style capture of altitude-web-components@1.0.2 in headless Chromium 149.0.7827.55; overflow channels in the sibling extension file. FLOOR-PROMOTED (examples/altitude/scripts/promote-floor.mjs): enriched.contract.json — computed-capture truth; minted leaves source-aliased to Altitude's own CSS-variable references where verified (source-bindings.json); extension sidecar carries the named overflow.
